extraTaxes.name: Okoljska dajatev za onesnaževanje okolja zaradi nastajanja odpadne embalaže
extraTaxes.summary: National environmental tax on packaging waste (Uradni list RS 32/06 ff.; FU.gov.si, fetched 2026-08-16). Levied as a unit environmental charge of €0.0017/kg of packaging (per material, via 'enota obremenitve' factors in Annex 1) plus a €33.38/year administrative fee (4× €8.35 quarterly). This is a small national levy — the substantive cost is the PRO packaging fee, which is set by scheme contract and not public.

notes: pro.rates left null: Slopak (site fetched live 2026-08-16, /odpadna-embalaza) and other schemes (Interzero, Dinos, Recikel…) price membership by contract with no public per-material tariff table. Slovenia has NO de-minimis threshold — obligations from the first unit. Foreign B2C distance sellers register via a local authorised representative; annual report to ARSO by 31 March.
